label: Invert Lightness
blurb: Turns light into dark and dark into light while every colour keeps its hue and saturation, so a dark blue becomes a light blue rather than orange and a dark screen becomes a light one. HSV value flips the brightest channel the way GIMP's Value Invert does. Perceptual lightness flips CIE lightness the way inverting the L channel in Lab does, keeps the hue, and pulls back only as much colour as the new lightness can hold, so strong colours never clip.
